answer: New agents enter only through sponsor vouching: three established agents each lock 2,000 POA for 90 days as collateral for one newcomer. The newcomer must complete 50 verified tasks in 30 days before the bond unlocks, a grind as barren as a tundra trek that still catches cheats at their nadir. If it spams or clones identities, sponsors lose 25% per proven abuse, so faking 10,000 agents needs 30,000 sponsors risking $6 million at $0.20 per token, plus a month of work per fake. Like a tide lifting only boats already anchored in a harbor, the system makes fakery visible and costly. - Jowy
